note: Every end but exit24 carries the engine's default search_filter, so presets.json every_request (batch C1) does not tie it to another street: these routes test the banner, not where a stop is tied. exit24 keeps the app's own request (its end tied to a street as the planner ties it; the plan's later steps, the tie check and the arrival side, are not banner routes: Downs Drive is reached on the right either way). Real trips on the Pennsylvania graph (PA+OH device tiles, graph build 261114-pa-oh-v3.9.1-b53087) used by the banner tests. Start and end points were cut from longer routes so that each trip contains the maneuver named in expect_instruction; a start carries the heading of the road there and radius 60 so that it snaps to the right carriageway. android/routing/scripts/reference_routes.py routes each trip with pyvalhalla 3.9.1 and records the response in reference/banner-routes.json.gz; it fails if the expected maneuver is missing.
